description: Rounding and division (measure contract section 1). round: value setScale(scale, mode), the seven modes at and around the half-way points, negatives included; expect is the plain text of the result (raising the scale appends zeros). divide: a / b to scale with mode; DIVISION_BY_ZERO for a zero divisor.
howToRun: Parse value, a and b as decimals; round or divide with the named mode; compare the plain text with expect, or the error code with error.
